{{Top|leg}}
The '''repulsorlift personal jump pack''' was a personal transport unit utilized by the [[cloud-jumper]]s of the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. Developed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Exocron]], it nevertheless resembled a popular brand of rug-cleaning [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from the galaxy at large.

The pack was not a true [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]], since it did not allow the user to fly. Instead, the pack allowed the user to make incredible leaps over two meters at a time. The pack could also be used to slow the descent of a free-falling individual to assist in a safe landing.
